title: [Shopify] Fix order edit retaining discount allocation for removed quantity
summary: The Shopify connector now correctly adjusts line-level discount amounts when refunds reduce order line quantities, preventing over-discounting of the remaining quantity in sales documents.
key_points: Fixed discount allocation calculation in refund processing to account for removed quantities
Discount amount is now reduced proportionally with quantity reduction using unit price and subtotal derivation
Added unit tests to verify discount reduction and quantity adjustment for discounted order lines
Ensures line discount reconciles with order header discount after quantity refunds
Only affects Shopify refund/return import when enabled
